proof: For every coordinate order, the standard monomials of the vanishing ideal form a basis for functions on $\mathcal H$, and their supports are the order-shattered sets for that order.  Their degrees are thus at most the largest order-shattered-set size.  Minimizing over orders gives $\mathrm{intdeg}(\mathcal H)\le\mathrm{OSH}_{\min}(\mathcal H)$.
name: Minimum Largest Order Shattered Set / Interpolation degree
